'''Graf Lind''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] hailing from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]]. A [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] affiliated with the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]], Lind was investigated by agents of the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
A pirate operating on Saleucami during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Graf Lind was associated with the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]] until he was cast out from their group for unknown reasons. Around this time, Lind lost his right leg to the Sorority, cobbling together a cheap prosthetic leg and walking with a polished [[Bubse tree/Legends|bubse]] wood cane which contained a [[Vibrorapier/Legends|vibrorapier]]. Living in the city of [[Taleucema]], Lind's residence in the overcrowded slum called the Warren had a single room and showed signs of decades of wear. Gaining the protection of a local street gang, as denoted by a single black X on the door, Lind maintained a simple routine which consisted of running errands at noon, and returning with food and [[Rotgut/Legends|rotgut]]. When the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] became suspicious of Lind's connection to the Sorority when the Consortium's ships began losing cargo to pirates, a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] was sent to investigate him.

*''[[Mask of the Pirate Queen]]''
